summary: Iteration 1 (first run). Backend: 23 pytest tests covering all 20 mandatory cases, the EV Rent partner API, all 13 reports in json/csv/xlsx, RBAC, and admin endpoint smoke tests. All 23 passed. test_06 failed once with a 401 on one admin call and passed when re-run. Frontend: Playwright with Clerk ticket sign-in. Passed: admin dashboard (KPIs, 9 charts, demo banner, session kept after refresh), create payment request dialog -> detail page, simulate success, receipt page, bank import wizard (auto column mapping, preview, import result), reconciliation run, unmatched-payments sheet LINK_TO_PAYMENT -> request SUCCESS, drivers sheet, reports CSV/XLSX download, supervisors role selects, Kotak switch disabled with notice, API key issued in UI, sync and webhook tabs, audit logs, settings save, supervisor's limited sidebar and city scope, pending-access screen and sign-out, mobile nav drawer. Main bugs: a list search race condition, no client-side route guard for finance-only pages, and native date pickers.

minor.issue: A real bank credit can be linked to a MOCK (simulated) payment request. The request keeps is_simulated=true and the SIMULATED badge, while the new txn has is_simulated=false, provider=MOCK and source MANUAL_RESOLUTION. This mixes real and simulated money. Restrict linking to STATIC_QR / non-simulated requests.

Not scoped per API client or system. Any active key, including MYVOLT/OTHER keys, can read any payment, driver history or receipt, and can create payments. Consider checking client.system == EV_RENT for create/utr/dispute.

Synchronous PyJWKClient fetch inside the async request path blocks the event loop on JWKS refresh. JWKS connection errors are a PyJWTError, so they surface as 401 'Invalid or expired session'. Likely cause of one 401 seen with a fresh (<25s) token during the test run.
A second dispute on the same day returns 200 with exception_id=null and status UNDER_REVIEW, but nothing is recorded (deduped silently). Return the existing exception id.

Every invalid-signature request stores up to 5KB of payload with no TTL. The only limit is 1200/min per IP, so the collection can grow without bound. Add a TTL index on REJECTED_SIGNATURE docs. The rate limiter is also in-memory and per process.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition. The search box fires a request on every change with no debounce, and useFetch has no stale-response guard (no AbortController or request-id check). A slower, earlier unfiltered response can overwrite filtered results. Seen in testing: searching a UTR on Unmatched Payments right after page load showed 6 unrelated rows. The API returns 1 for the same query. Affects every list page.

No role-based route guard. A supervisor opening /bank directly sees the finance Bank Transactions page, including the 'Import statement' button. The API returns 403 but the UI shows 'No records found' with no access-denied message. The same likely applies to /reports, /reconciliation, /settlements, /settings, /audit, /integrations, /providers and /supervisors. The backend is secure; this is UI only.
'Create payment request' is enabled when Payable now is ₹0.00, so clicking it will hit a 409. Disable it or explain why.
Sync status stays 'Sync Pending' after the worker has synced; it only updates on manual reload. Consider polling while status is SYNC_PENDING or RETRY_PENDING.

design_issues.screen: Bank transactions / list filters / Reports date range
issues: DateInput uses the browser's native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker
The run-reconciliation toast shows raw JSON, e.g. 'Run RUN-...: {"MISSING_IN_BANK":0}'. Format the counts.
The recent payment requests table overflows horizontally (RECON column cut off) at 1920 width in the sm:max-w-xl sheet
The 'Joined' column shows '—' for every user (created_at missing or not rendered)
Console a11y warning: a DialogContent has no DialogTitle
Nav data-testids are duplicated because the sidebar renders twice (desktop and mobile drawer), so automated tests must scope them

action_items: Add a stale-response guard (AbortController or request counter) to useFetch and debounce the ListTable search (about 300ms)
Add role-based route guards using me.permissions/role: redirect or show access-denied for finance/admin-only routes, and hide finance actions for supervisors
Replace the native date inputs (kit.jsx DateInput) with a shadcn Calendar + Popover
Block LINK_TO_PAYMENT on simulated (MOCK) requests, or label the result clearly
Scope the partner API by api client system (EV_RENT) and consider per-client ownership checks
Run Clerk JWKS verification off the event loop (run_in_threadpool) and distinguish JWKS fetch errors (503) from invalid tokens (401)
Minor UX: disable the driver-sheet create button when payable is 0, poll sync status on the detail page, format the recon toast, add DialogTitle
critical_code_review_comments: engine.record_success: residual outstanding uses the req['total_payable'] snapshot taken when the request was created. If MyVolt outstanding changes between creation and confirmation, the update overwrites it. Use $inc or recompute.

recon.run_reconciliation: the MISSING_IN_BANK update_many covers every non-simulated success in the global bank window, not just the current import. That is acceptable, but it can flip txns from unrelated periods once statements span long ranges.
routes_v1 webhook: provider path is upper-cased, but unknown providers return 404 without being logged. Fine, but consider auditing.
useFetch: an error state exists, but ListTable never renders it, so 403/500 errors show as 'No records found'

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23; test_06 flaky once with an intermittent 401)
success_rate.frontend: about 90% (all flows work; route-guard and search-race bugs)

flaky_tests: test_06_static_qr_no_auto_assign_and_ambiguous: 1 failure in 2 runs, a 401 from /api/bank/transactions with a fresh Clerk token. Passed on retry.
test_credentials: Used the existing Clerk users in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin, finance, supervisor [Chennai], pending). They were not modified.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_DRV-*/TEST_VEH-* drivers directly in mongo and delete them, plus their requests, txns, receipts, sync logs and exceptions, by id at session end. Bank rows from test imports are deleted by import_id. TEST_ API clients are revoked. Settings toggles were restored to false. UI-created data (2 TEST drivers, 1 import, 1 API key) was cleaned manually. Seed DEMO data was not modified. Audit-log and webhook entries from tests remain, as they are append-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (about 150s, needs CLERK_SECRET_KEY and MONGO_URL read from backend/.env via dotenv; values are never printed). conftest.ClerkClient refreshes 60s Clerk JWTs every 25s. UI sign-in: python /app/backend/tests/make_tickets.py admin supervisor pending -> /tmp/tickets.json (single-use tickets), open /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t>. TEST drivers for UI: python /app/backend/tests/ui_fixture.py setup | cleanup <ids>. Primary provider is MOCK; STATIC_QR is enabled. Retest after fixes: list search race, supervisor route guards, date picker.
rca of the issue: Search race: ListPage.jsx sets state.q on every onChange, and lib/api.js useFetch calls setData(r.data) for whichever response resolves last, with no cancellation. Reproduce: open /exceptions and immediately type a UTR; the table can show the initial unfiltered page. Fix: AbortController in the useFetch effect cleanup, or ignore responses whose key differs from the latest, plus a debounced q.
